He’s full of energy, motivates you throughout, and makes the session so much fun. His hype keeps you going even when you feel tired. The class was not only a great workout but also super engaging. Highly recommend if you’re looking for fitness with big energy and positive vibes!

featured_reviews.name: Sanam Chowdhry
featured_reviews.review_text:
Working out with Anuj at AK Fitness is an all rounder experience. It’s fun, there’s something new to look forward to with every session and it is a constant reminder of why you started.
The space is neat and has all the right equipments to give you the experience you’ve been looking for with flexible timings to suit your schedule/routine.

My favorite at the studio is Boxing. As a beginner I started off with feeling intimidated & here I am looking forward to the next session every single week, in just a couple months!

Love my mornings at AK Fitness, Lokhandwala!

featured_reviews.name: Shivam
featured_reviews.review_text: Great gym with excellent trainer and a motivating atmosphere. The trainer is knowledgeable, workouts are well-structured, and the focus on strength, mobility, and overall fitness really makes a difference. Perfect place for anyone serious about training.

featured_reviews.name: Noopur Agarwal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been working out with Anuj since quite sometime but the AK Fitness studio that he has recently started is a whole new experience in itself.
If you are someone who loves variety in their workouts and get bored of monotonous workouts trust me this is the place to be.
P.S- You definitely get to blow that steam on those boxing bags.
Boxing is the highlight of his classes, something that is definitely not easily available and that too with so much precision.
In my opinion don't think if it is in your vicinity your lucky!!

featured_reviews.name: Manu Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: Anuj’s training is next level. His energy is motivating without being overwhelming and he really knows his craft. Boxing sessions are sharp and technical, while the conditioning workouts hit hard while being smartly structured and every session challenges you to get a step closer to your fitter self. If you want to get stronger, fitter and actually start enjoying training, this is the spot and Anuj is your guy. Highly recommend AK Fitness.

featured_reviews.name: Turtle singh
featured_reviews.review_text: What makes AK FITNESS truly special is the personal attention and guidance from ANUJ . His knowledge, passion, and dedication to fitness are unmatched. He doesn’t just push you to work harder; he makes sure you’re working smarter, with the right techniques and a plan that suits your goals …

featured_reviews.name: Rashmi Chandra
featured_reviews.review_text: AK fitness is a complete packeage to reach your goal. I have been knowing Anuj sir for long … he is best in boxing and HIIT workout.

featured_reviews.name: Modita Dhavale
featured_reviews.review_text: I started training with Anuj about a year ago and the intensity of the workouts was the perfect fit for me. Tried the boxing bag workout for the first time and my stress didn’t survive round one. Though I couldn't continue in Mumbai due to some personal reasons, I came across the option of his online training facility. Immediately enrolled for it, without giving a second thought and have no regrets. Be it gym workouts or at-home body weight exercises, Anuj makes sure that the workout routines are enjoyable and challenging. He is also available to answer the silliest queries, provide customized workout plans as per your goals and always motivates and supports you throughout, which helps in boosting the confidence and morale. Would surely love to continue training with him for as long as possible and urge to whosoever it is possible to give it a try and it will be the best decision in your fitness journey.

featured_reviews.name: Sanavi Jhawer
featured_reviews.review_text: I genuinely love this gym. I’ve been here for over 6 months now. The trainers are incredibly sweet. Siddhart sir , my trainer has trained me and guided me in improving my strength. Without him this would be a difficult journey. They never deny to teach or help out in any manner. The environment of the gym is also very friendly. Plus points for the interiors. Truly luxurious and well maintained with consistent cleaning!!

featured_reviews.name: Jai kanik
featured_reviews.review_text: I’ve had a great experience training at Sykz Gym Lokhandwala. Been training my clients there since 2020 The facility is well-maintained, the equipment is up to date, and the atmosphere is very motivating. The trainers are knowledgeable and supportive without being pushy. amol sir does really good job maintaining the gym facility and machines. Overall, it’s a solid place to work out and stay consistent. Definitely worth checking out if you’re in the area.

featured_reviews.name: fara shaiwalla
featured_reviews.review_text: I've been training with Prem for a month and overall it's been a very positive experience. He is knowlegable, motivating and genuinely care about helping me reach my fitness goals. The workouts are well-structured, challenging, and effective. I highly recommend him to anyone looking for a dedictaed and professional personal trainer.

featured_reviews.name: Aakash Tiwari
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing experience at Skyz Gym, Juhu. The management is highly unprofessional and seems completely uninterested in maintaining a positive environment for members. Many of the staff and trainers come across as egoistic, rude, and unapproachable, which makes the gym atmosphere uncomfortable rather than motivating.

On top of that, the crowd management is terrible — members constantly leave weights scattered instead of re-racking them, and shoes and bags are left lying around everywhere, making the place look messy and unsafe. For a gym in such a prime location, the lack of discipline, courtesy, and proper supervision is unacceptable.

featured_reviews.name: sachin kadam
featured_reviews.review_text: Very positive wibs . All trainers are very helpful and knowledgeable. Boxing class is impressive and zumba class is also nice. Amol sir is my favourite coach.

featured_reviews.name: Guru Bro
featured_reviews.review_text: I joined this gym in april 2024. the machines are good—some are a bit outdated, but they’re going to be replaced. the outdoor functional area is really fun to work out in. the trainers are very nice and friendly—amol sir, pradeep sir, rakesh sir, rizwan sir, umesh sir, mandar sir, and nilesh sir are all very knowledgeable and supportive. overall, it’s a good gym to work out in and definitely worth the price.

featured_reviews.name: Ravi Seth
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have practically spend 15 years in Sykz Gym. I have been training my clients since 2002 October as a Free Lancer Personal Trainer. I have the best experience in it. Ambiance is awesome. Equipment’s are all up to date. Cardio section fully functional at all times. Well maintained changing rooms good staff. Very co operative to everyone. Sykz gym staff welcomes everyone with open arms. Any free lancer personal trainer can come to Sykz gym with their clients and enjoy training there. In short staff is very friendly, they make you feel you’re home. Very comfortable place to be in. Without a shadow of doubt the One is the best Fully functional Gym in Andheri West area.
They have a huge terrace open area to do functional training group sessions. I can keep going with the awesomeness...
I have transformed more then 3000 clients in 15 years of my profession. I train kids with Outdoor speed drills workouts and have made them Gold Medalist in sports.. for this I’ll make another Review on Lokhandwala Back road training..

Please Note: Always train under an experienced certified personal trainer. Safety is the first priority in training.

Cheers to healthy living...:-))))

featured_reviews.review_text: A well equipped and clean gym. The gym has sufficient machines, dumbells, etc, locker facility for bags and valuables, also toilet and shower facilities for its members.Parking can be difficult so thankfully the gym has free valet .The trainers in the gym are very helpful and are present on the floor to guide you incase you have any questions about form or excercise s. I have been really enjoying my PT sessions and would highly recommend not only him but also this gym to others.
